stories.title: La jueza pide con «urgencia» a Vivas las llamadas que intercambió con Sánchez por la invasión de Ceuta

en.title: Judge urgently requests call records between Vivas and Sánchez regarding Ceuta invasion
en.summary: A National Court judge investigating the mass arrival of people from Morocco to Ceuta in July is requesting phone records between the city's president and Spain's Prime Minister, specifically calls made between July 27-30.

stories.title: Llarena levanta la orden de detención del expresident tras conocer el fallo

en.title: Llarena lifts arrest warrant for former president following court ruling
en.summary: A Supreme Court judge has withdrawn national arrest and search warrants for former Catalan president Carles Puigdemont and two other former officials following a Constitutional Court ruling on amnesty eligibility.

stories.title: El TC borra la malversación del 'procés', enmienda al Supremo y permite la vuelta de Puigdemont

en.title: Constitutional Court removes embezzlement charges from 'procés', overrules Supreme Court and permits Puigdemont's return
en.summary: Spain's Constitutional Court has ruled in favor of applying amnesty to embezzlement charges against Catalan independence leaders, removing the final legal obstacle to their reinstatement and enabling Puigdemont's potential return.

stories.title: El novio de la joven Ana Buza, absuelto de su muerte en la carretera tras declararlo no culpable el jurado

en.title: Boyfriend of young woman Ana Buza acquitted of her death on road after jury finds him not guilty
en.summary: A man has been acquitted in the death of his girlfriend on a road, with a jury rejecting claims that he struck her as the culmination of a toxic relationship, as her family had alleged.

stories.title: El jurado popular absuelve al novio de Ana Buza: ni la atropelló ni propició su muerte

en.title: Jury acquits Ana Buza's boyfriend: he neither hit her nor caused her death
en.summary: A jury in Seville found Ana Buza's boyfriend not guilty of causing the 19-year-old's death in a September 2019 car incident. The verdict of acquittal came after an extended trial.

stories.title: Alemania detiene por presunto espionaje y traición al exjefe de los servicios secretos

en.title: Germany detains former head of secret services on suspected espionage and treason charges
en.summary: German authorities arrested August Hanning, who previously led Germany's security agencies, and another high-ranking BND official on suspicion of treason and espionage. The arrests occurred in North Rhine-Westphalia and Bavaria.

stories.title: Shakira pide a Piqué que sea él quien se traslade a Miami a ver a sus hijos para proteger “su bienestar emocional, físico y académico”

en.title: Shakira asks Piqué to travel to Miami to see their children to protect their emotional, physical and academic wellbeing
en.summary: Shakira and former footballer Piqué appeared in Barcelona court to determine custody arrangements for their two children, who have lived with the singer in the United States since 2023.

stories.title: Así queda la regulación de la vivienda tras el rescate de los decretos Maricarmen: 10.000 millones de financiación para la compra de la primera vivienda, la prórroga de dos años de los alquileres y el pago público de los costes de los desahucios

en.title: Housing regulation takes shape after rescue of Maricarmen decrees: 10 billion euros in financing for first-home purchases, two-year rental extension, and public coverage of eviction costs
en.summary: New housing measures include 10 billion euros in first-home purchase financing, a two-year extension of rental protections, and public payment of eviction expenses. Implementation requires approval from the Permanent Delegation.

stories.title: El Constitucional ampara a los líderes del 'procés' y Llarena levanta la orden de detención contra Puigdemont que podrá regresar ya a España

en.title: Constitutional Court protects 'process' leaders and Llarena lifts detention order against Puigdemont who can now return to Spain
en.summary: Spain's Constitutional Court ruled in favor of former regional officials involved in Catalonia's independence movement, prompting the Supreme Court judge to lift the arrest warrant against former regional president Puigdemont, allowing him to return to Spain.

stories.title: El TC ordena aplicar la amnistía, Llarena levanta la orden de detención de Puigdemont: ¿Y ahora qué?

en.title: Constitutional Court orders amnesty application, Llarena lifts Puigdemont detention order: And now what?
en.summary: Spain's Constitutional Court ordered amnesty implementation for those involved in Catalonia's independence movement, with the Supreme Court judge lifting the arrest warrant against the former regional president, potentially affecting all related cases.

stories.title: El Supremo levanta la orden de detención a Puigdemont, pero no le aplica todavía la amnistía

en.title: Supreme Court lifts detention order for Puigdemont, but does not yet apply amnesty
en.summary: The Supreme Court judge lifted the arrest warrant against the former regional president and two others, but deferred the amnesty decision pending analysis of the Constitutional Court's ruling.

stories.title: El TC ordena al Supremo amnistiar a los líderes del procés y abre la vía al retorno de Puigdemont

en.title: Constitutional Court orders Supreme Court to grant amnesty to process leaders and opens path for Puigdemont's return
en.summary: Spain's Constitutional Court voted seven to five to approve amnesty for those involved in Catalonia's independence movement, enabling the former regional president's return once the Supreme Court judge lifts his detention order.

stories.title: La patronal se rebela contra la huelga general: "Es inadmisible"

en.title: Business groups rebel against general strike: "It is inadmissible"
en.summary: CEOE and Cepyme employers' organizations plan to analyze the strike's conditions when published and potentially challenge its legality in court.

stories.title: El Ibex supera los 19.400 puntos en su tercera sesión al alza

en.title: Ibex surpasses 19,400 points in its third consecutive up session
en.summary: The Spanish stock index touches new 2022 highs while US debt interest and French risk premiums create mixed trading sentiment on the market.

stories.title: Ayesa Digital compra Kuik para acelerar su negocio de IA

en.title: Ayesa Digital acquires Kuik to accelerate its AI business
en.summary: Ayesa Digital has purchased Kuik, a company specializing in artificial intelligence application and software engineering for process transformation and results improvement.

stories.title: El PNV apoyará el primer decreto de vivienda en la Diputación Permanente

en.title: PNV will support the first housing decree in the Permanent Delegation
en.summary: The Basque political party will back the housing decree while maintaining that approved measures remain insufficient and do not independently resolve the housing problem.

stories.title: Ayuso anuncia una ley contra la burocracia: cada nueva norma exigirá derogar otra

en.title: Ayuso announces law against bureaucracy: each new regulation will require repealing another
en.summary: Madrid's regional president proposes legislation requiring the repeal of an existing law for each new one approved. New business obligations would only take effect on two fixed annual dates, and legal challenges are planned against certain government decrees.
